title: Tournament A: 8 dynamics/physics mechanisms all hit walls; Koopman orbit spectrum null
question: Idea tournament A (ECDLP-64, dynamics/physics-inspired mechanisms): 8 new mechanisms, none survives. A1 Koopman/Prony/DMD on the translation orbit f(jP) (sparse spectrum would compare P and Q orbits by phase): passed the paper gate conditionally, killed by pre-registered test (9 prime-order curves at 16/20/24 bits, 3 seeds, N=400, 6 observables): Hankel participation-ratio z in [-2.6,+2.2] (threshold -3 never met), AR(30) one-step NMSE 1.03-1.61 (threshold 0.9), Berlekamp-Massey linear complexity exactly 200 on all 18 raw x/y sequences (= random), planted 5-frequency control detected on all 9 curves (PR <= 5.04, NMSE ~0.005). Killed on paper: A2 Metropolis-biased walk (generic bound, = DP rho), A3 commuting maps / Lattes dynamics of [m] (orbits depend on k only via ord_r(m)), A4 belief propagation on bit-decomposition graph (exact BP = BSGS/MITM), A5 renormalisation of k (Z/r has no filtration; MSB block-spin closed by round 20), A6 p-adic canonical-lift energy landscape (linear coordinate lives on the p-part, Q component 0), A7 diffusion-map embedding of Hecke chain (needs distance oracle = leak), A8 cat-map dynamics on E x E (bijective, no birthday). Common obstruction: group operations are bijections with known coefficients (no birthday) and any non-injective ingredient is an equidistributed x-hash; a new dynamical idea needs a computable non-injective map on points with non-uniform collisions.
rationale: User directive 2026-11-03: original research, not re-testing literature.
